mission_06: Communication efficiency is critical in federated learning because model updates can be large (millions of parameters) and clients may have limited bandwidth. This mission implements two complementary compression techniques. Top-k sparsification keeps only the k largest-magnitude elements of the update, setting the rest to zero. This can reduce communication by 99% or more while preserving the most important gradient information. Quantization maps continuous values to a discrete set of levels (e.g., 8-bit = 256 levels), reducing the bits needed per parameter. Combining both techniques achieves dramatic communication savings. The decompression step reconstructs the full update on the server side. While compression introduces some information loss, the iterative nature of FL allows the model to recover over multiple rounds.
